name: How do I choose the right contractor for aging-in-place renovations?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for aging-in-place renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for aging-in-place renovations, look for experience in accessible design and a strong understanding of safety standards. Verify their licensing and insurance, and ask for references from previous clients who had similar work done. A reputable contractor will provide a clear, detailed estimate, demonstrate good communication, and be able to guide you through the process, including permit requirements specific to your area like Las Vegas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in accessible design, verify their license and insurance, check references, and ensure they provide clear estimates and good communication.
